answer.reason: The verses add little beyond the summary, but the sign that Hophni and his brother would die in one day is something that happened to him.

clauses.english: was foretold to die with his brother Phinehas in one day
clauses.quote: in one day they shall die both of them

doubts: His death at the Philistines' hands (1SA 4:11, 4:17) is already in the summary, so I did not repeat it.
1SA 4:4 only says he was with the ark at Shiloh, and does not say he went with it into battle.
